features.content:

With MSG91 Segmento, you can create customer segments based on audience attributes, website activity, preferences, purchase history, and other customer data. features.name: RCS for Healthcare
features.content:
Make Patient Communication Easier RCS helps hospitals, clinics, labs and pharmacies send clear, interactive messages to patients without repeated phone calls. Patients see your hospital’s verified name and logo, so they know the message is genuine and not a scam.

MSG91’s AI chatbot can handle the full appointment process on RCS. It checks each doctor’s real-time availability, books the slot, and reschedules or cancels when the patient asks. It connects with your hospital system, calendar and 2,000+ apps. The bot also answers questions about doctors, fees and timings in many languages, 24/7, and hands the chat to your staff when needed. Transactional RCS messages start at just ₹0.12 each.

Banks, NBFCs, fintech apps and insurance companies are among the biggest users of RCS in India. Finance and fintech make up over three-quarters of RCS traffic in India. Every message shows your verified brand profile, which helps customers tell real messages from phishing and fraud texts.

Send OTPs, transaction alerts and EMI reminders on RCS, with automatic SMS fallback so critical messages always reach the customer. MSG91’s AI chatbot can connect to your systems through APIs to answer questions about loan status, EMIs or account services, 24/7.

Use promotional RCS to grow your business too. Promote credit cards, loans, insurance plans and investment products with rich cards, images, documents and Apply Now buttons.

faqs.question: What is RCS Business Messaging, and how is it different from SMS?
faqs.answer: RCS Business Messaging is an upgraded version of SMS that allows businesses to send verified, branded, and interactive messages through customers' default messaging apps. Unlike traditional SMS, RCS includes business logos, verified sender profiles, images, videos, PDFs, Rich Cards, carousels, interactive buttons, read receipts, and two-way conversations. SMS remains useful for OTPs, basic notifications, and fallback delivery. Customers can receive RCS messages without downloading a separate app.

faqs.question: Is RCS Business Messaging available in India, and does it work on iPhones?
faqs.answer: Yes. RCS Business Messaging works in India on compatible Android devices and iPhones. Currently, MSG91's RCS iPhone delivery is available for eligible Jio numbers only, and this feature is included in the Grow plan. Customers receive messages through their phone's default messaging app, such as Google Messages on Android or Messages on iPhone, with RCS enabled.

faqs.question: Is RCS Business Messaging safe for customers?
faqs.answer: RCS Business Messaging uses verified business sender profiles that display the registered business name and logo. This helps customers recognize legitimate business communications and distinguish them from unfamiliar senders. Businesses can use verified RCS messaging for account updates, payment notifications, promotional campaigns, and customer interactions.

faqs.question: RCS vs WhatsApp: Which is better and more cost-effective for businesses in India?
faqs.answer: Both RCS and WhatsApp serve different communication needs. RCS reaches customers through their default messaging inbox with verified branding, rich media, and interactive actions, while WhatsApp is useful for ongoing customer conversations and support. MSG91's promotional RCS messages start at ₹0.29 per message, which can be more cost-effective than WhatsApp marketing messages depending on the applicable rates and campaign requirements. With MSG91, businesses can use both channels and create automated fallback workflows across RCS, WhatsApp, SMS, and Email. Compare MSG91 WhatsApp pricing and RCS pricing to evaluate costs.

faqs.question: How can e-commerce, D2C, and other industries use RCS Business Messaging in India?
faqs.answer: E-commerce and D2C brands can showcase products through interactive carousels, recover abandoned carts, promote festive offers, and share order and delivery updates. Banking and fintech businesses can send transaction alerts and authentication messages, while healthcare providers can manage appointment reminders. RCS also helps insurance, telecom, education, real estate, automobile, and travel businesses deliver branded notifications, interactive campaigns, and customer support.

faqs.question: Why Should Businesses Use RCS Business Messaging?
faqs.answer: RCS is one of the fastest-growing business communication channels, enabling brands to engage customers through verified messaging, rich media, interactive buttons, and AI-powered conversations. It helps businesses build trust, improve engagement, and drive conversions directly through customers' default messaging apps.

faqs.question: Can businesses send OTPs and promotional messages through RCS?
faqs.answer: Yes. Businesses can use RCS for OTPs, authentication messages, product launches, personalized offers, festive campaigns, and customer notifications. Promotional RCS messages must be sent to customers who have provided the required consent. If an RCS OTP fails to deliver, MSG91 can automatically retry it through SMS using an RCS-to-SMS fallback workflow.

faqs.question: What RCS message types/formats and interactive actions does MSG91 support?
faqs.answer: MSG91 supports four RCS message formats—Text Message, Rich Card, Carousel, and Carousel with Video—along with six interactive actions: Suggested Replies, Open URL, Dial, Create Calendar Event, View Location, and Share Location. Businesses can use these to showcase products, share information, and help customers take action directly from their messages.

faqs.question: Can customers reply to RCS messages, and does MSG91 support multilingual AI chatbots?
faqs.answer: Yes. Customers can reply to RCS messages through text or suggested replies. MSG91's multilingual AI-powered chatbot can handle FAQs, product enquiries, order updates, and complex, multi-step requests in multiple languages, enabling businesses to communicate with customers in their preferred language. With connected business systems, the chatbot can retrieve information and assist with relevant actions. When human assistance is needed, conversations can be seamlessly transferred to support agents through MSG91 Hello.

faqs.question: Can businesses track RCS campaign performance?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 provides detailed RCS campaign analytics, including sent messages, delivery status, read receipts, and customer interactions such as button clicks. Businesses can monitor campaign performance, understand customer engagement, compare results, and improve future RCS marketing campaigns.

faqs.question: How much does RCS Business Messaging cost in India?
faqs.answer:
MSG91 offers three RCS Business Messaging plans for businesses in India:
  • Launch – ₹2,000/month: ₹0.15 per transactional message and ₹0.35 per promotional message.
  • Build – ₹5,000/month: ₹0.12 per transactional message and ₹0.32 per promotional message.
  • Grow – ₹10,000/month: ₹0.12 per transactional message and ₹0.29 per promotional message.
Each plan includes RCS wallet credit equal to its monthly price, with 18% GST charged separately. Promotional and transactional RCS agents require separate plans. (Prices till October 2026)

For plan features, volume requirements, and the latest rates, explore MSG91 RCS Pricing in India.

faqs.question: Which MSG91 RCS pricing plan offers the lowest rates, and can businesses get custom pricing?
faqs.answer: The Grow plan at ₹10,000/month offers the lowest promotional RCS rate of ₹0.29 per message and a transactional rate of ₹0.12 per message. Its ₹10,000 RCS wallet can cover approximately 34,482 promotional messages if used entirely for promotional messaging. Grow also includes RCS iPhone Delivery for eligible Jio numbers. Businesses with higher messaging volumes can contact the MSG91 sales team for customized pricing.

faqs.question: Does MSG91 charge for failed RCS messages or SMS fallback?
faqs.answer: No. MSG91 does not charge for failed RCS messages under its stated billing terms. However, when automatic fallback sends messages through SMS, charges apply according to the number of SMS messages sent and the applicable MSG91 SMS pricing. WhatsApp and Email fallback messages are billed according to their respective channel rates.

faqs.question: Do businesses need separate plans for promotional and transactional RCS messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each RCS agent requires its own plan. Businesses using separate promotional and transactional RCS agents must purchase an individual plan for each. MSG91's onboarding team can help businesses choose the appropriate plans based on their communication requirements.

faqs.question: Can businesses send bulk RCS messages without coding or integrate an RCS API?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91's Send RCS panel allows businesses to upload customer numbers through a CSV file and send bulk RCS campaigns to lakhs of customers directly from the dashboard without coding. AI-powered template creation helps businesses prepare messages quickly. For automated communication, the MSG91 RCS Business Messaging API connects with websites, applications, and CRM systems to trigger order confirmations, shipping updates, appointment reminders, and other notifications.

faqs.question: What documents are required for RCS registration in India?
faqs.answer:
Businesses registering an RCS sender with MSG91 need:
  • GST certificate and PAN card.
  • Brand logo measuring 224 × 224 pixels with a white background.
  • Hero banner measuring 1440 × 448 pixels with a white background.
  • Proof of customer opt-in, including a screenshot and URL.
  • MSG91 account details.
  • Opt-in on their Website
The MSG91 onboarding team guides businesses through documentation, agent registration, and verification.

faqs.question: Do I need DLT registration for RCS Business Messaging in India, and how long does verification take?
faqs.answer: No. DLT registration is not required specifically for RCS Business Messaging in India. However, businesses using SMS fallback must follow applicable SMS and DLT compliance requirements. RCS Agent verification timelines depend on the completeness of submitted documents and the approval process. MSG91's onboarding team checks your requirements, guides you through registration, and helps prioritize verification.

faqs.question: Do customers need to opt in before receiving RCS messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Businesses must obtain the required customer consent before sending RCS messages. Proof of customer opt-in, including a screenshot and relevant URL, is part of the RCS registration requirements. This helps businesses maintain permission-based communication and follow applicable messaging guidelines.

faqs.question: What happens if an RCS message fails to deliver, and how quickly are messages delivered?
faqs.answer: RCS messages are delivered in near real time, similar to SMS. Once your RCS agent is verified and activated, you can start sending campaigns and automated notifications. If an RCS message fails, MSG91 can automatically retry communication through SMS, WhatsApp, or Email based on your selected fallback workflow. This creates another opportunity to reach customers without manually resending messages.

faqs.question: Why choose MSG91 as an RCS Business Messaging provider in India?
faqs.answer: MSG91 combines verified RCS messaging, no-code campaigns, API integrations, AI-powered chatbots, and multichannel fallback in one communication platform. Businesses can start with plans from ₹2,000/month, access RCS promotional rates from ₹0.29 per message, and manage customer conversations through Hello. MSG91 also provides onboarding assistance, technical support, and messaging solutions for customers across 192 countries.

faqs.question: Can I try RCS Business Messaging before signing up, and how do I get started with MSG91?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 provides a live RCS experience through a QR code that allows users with RCS-enabled Android devices to explore branded and interactive messaging. Businesses can also request a personalized demo. To get started, create an MSG91 account and schedule a meeting with the MSG91 RCS specialist team. Submit your business documents for verification and RCS agent registration, prepare your message templates, and choose between dashboard-based campaigns and API integration. MSG91 provides onboarding, template, API, campaign, and delivery-related support through email, WhatsApp, phone calls, and scheduled meetings.
